top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the original theoretical prediction of the Z2 quantum spin Hall state (Kane, Mele) and its first experimental observation in HgTe quantum wells (Molenkamp), a verified discovery with an unbroken theory-to-experiment chain, about eighteen years of independent confirmation, and a citation scope that matches who did the original work. No award is clearly worse than a mature, verified discovery of this kind.
